mutation.description: applies the rule to only part of the figure

explanation: The rule is applied in two directions: Rows rotate by 90° and move by (0.07, 0.04); columns reflect across the vertical axis and change colour. Reading across each row and down each column gives the same local/global pattern. The missing bottom-right figure must therefore apply both changes. Option A is correct because it applies rotate by 90° and move by (0.07, 0.04) and reflect across the vertical axis and change colour. Other options omit one change or use a plausible wrong direction, rotation, fill, or element count.
explanationFragments: Rule: rotate by 90° and move by (0.07, 0.04) and reflect across the vertical axis and change colour.
Answer: option A continues that rule.
Distractors: each wrong option records the visual mutation it makes.
